_what: SEATS RE-DRAWN, AND WHY. Added, never edited; entries accumulate.
RULED (Rafe, 2026-09-08): "a seat voided by a mis-tagged plant is re-drawn, not the round;
a correct plant missed still voids. Record by added artifact."
The distinction is whose fault the miss is. A seat that misses a plant CORRECTLY TAGGED for
the axis it was asked about is soft, and softness voids the round — that is the only control
the mechanism has and nothing here touches it. A seat handed a plant that could not test the
question it was set was never judged at all, and re-running two innocent seats over it throws
This file is the added artifact the ruling requires, on the same principle as PARK-CLEARED:
a guard is cleared by ADDING evidence, never by deleting it.
It is excluded from build_id BY NAME, beside PARK-CLEARED.json — it describes a round and
reaches no pixel. Named, never a pattern: an unnamed file at the repo root still moves the
id, and prove_build_id case 6b holds that line.
